**Publish gate report: landing hero**

**Going out:** Landing page hero, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "you'll love it or it's free" | Not allowed. Policy section 3 bans this guarantee and says we have no such offer. Remove. |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | On the policy list (Subscription terms). Fine. |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list (Shipping policy). Fine. |
| "most boxes ship free" | Unproven. We have no data on order sizes, so this implies a share of orders we can't back up. Remove. |
| "Tea that's easy to stop and start" | Fine, it's a plain paraphrase of the pause/cancel term. |

**Regulated claims:** The guarantee and the "most boxes ship free" line both touch price/offer wording. The guarantee is an offer that doesn't exist, so it can't go out. No health, environment or children's content.

**House style:** No banned words. The copy is a bit clunky ("easy to stop and start, and...") and the sentence runs two ideas together. I've rewritten it to be warmer and plainer.

**Disclosure:** Our own landing page, no creators, affiliates or AI-labelling issues. Pass.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite):**
> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Pause or cancel your subscription any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

**Needs a decision:** None, if you accept the rewrite. If the team wants a guarantee, it would need a real offer added to the policy first.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). Nothing is published until Sam gives an explicit yes to the exact rewritten text above.
